column3: “Had ... beaten” makes the direct action of striking causative.
“Magor-missabib” retains the name rather than translating its meaning, terror on every side.
“His message” identifies the implicit subject of the burning fire.
“Trusted friends” renders the literal expression people of my peace.
“Heart and mind” replaces kidneys and heart and reverses their order; “committed” renders revealing the case.
“Male” is not explicitly retained in the announcement of a son.
